summary: Independently validated Phases E (documents overhaul), F (auto-onboarding on convert + welcome email) and G (event-scoped Check-In Volunteer permissions) via a new pytest suite (22 tests) + Playwright UI runs of /portal/documents as staff and as an ambassador member, plus regression of Phases A-D (151 tests). All Phase E/F/G happy paths and the full authz matrix pass. Found 5 backend hardening/security issues (most notable: /documents/{id}/sign has NO visibility check, and PUT /documents/{id} with a partial body silently wipes audience/assignments) and 1 minor UI label bug. No blockers; all test artifacts cleaned up and evt_246d20a66b31 left Approved/published with checkin_assignees=[].

critical.issue: No visibility/assignment check. A non-staff member (tok_memba) can sign a private_draft or admins_only document they cannot see (verified 200 + signature row created). Side effect: the signature then permanently blocks deletion of the staff's private draft. Should mirror _doc_visible_to and 403.

Uses full DocumentIn with defaults, so any partial payload resets audience->'private_draft' and clears assigned_to/assigned_roles. Verified: doc with audience=specific_members + assigned_to=[mem_memba] + roles=[ambassador] became private_draft with empty assignments after PUT {title,category}. Members lose access silently. Use exclude_unset / merge, or a dedicated DocumentEditIn.

minor.issue: audience is not validated against DOC_AUDIENCES — 'not_a_real_audience' is accepted and results in a doc invisible to everyone (falls through _doc_visible_to).
No existence check: archiving a non-existent id returns 200 with body null instead of 404 (all other doc endpoints 404).

No status gate — converting an application still in 'New' (never Approved) succeeds and creates a member + fires onboarding assignment + welcome email. Spec is 'convert an approved application'; should 400 unless status in (Approved) (or Recommended).

Delete guard checks signatures/assigned_to/audience but not assigned_roles. Legacy docs stored without an 'audience' field but with assigned_roles (e.g. existing doc_9464f19b023a, roles=[ambassador]) are therefore deletable even though members see them.

Provider 429 (Too Many Requests) from integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send is logged as status 'failed' with no retry/backoff. Under sustained testing every email (welcome + registration confirmations) failed. Recommend retry with backoff or a queue so transient 429 does not permanently mark member-facing emails failed.

ui_bugs.issue: Legacy documents saved without an 'audience' field render the meta line as 'Onboarding · Required · undefined · 0 assigned · 0 signed' (audLabel returns undefined). Needs a fallback (e.g. treat missing audience as Private Draft).
Minor: 'Assign to all active' menu item has no data-testid (Edit/Archive/Delete do); DialogContent triggers a11y console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'.

action_items: Add visibility enforcement to POST /api/documents/{id}/sign (403 when _doc_visible_to is False).
Make PUT /api/documents/{id} non-destructive (exclude_unset / merge) so audience + assigned_to + assigned_roles are preserved on partial edits.
Validate audience against DOC_AUDIENCES on create/edit; return 404 from PUT /documents/{id}/archive when the doc does not exist.
Gate POST /applications/{id}/convert on an approved application status.
Include assigned_roles in the DELETE /documents/{id} guard (and default missing audience to private_draft).
Consider retry/backoff for email provider 429s so welcome/confirmation emails are not permanently 'failed'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2826 lines — split into routers (documents, events/registrations, applications/members, email) before it grows further.
edit_document/create_document share no validation helper; audience + role lists should be validated in a Pydantic validator on DocumentIn.
_doc_visible_to supports 'interns_only'/role 'intern' but ROLES has no 'intern' — dead branch or missing role definition.

Phase C bulk endpoint now returns 400 for invalid action/payment value (older tests asserted 200/affected=0) and PUT /registrations/{id}/payment no longer records history for a no-op status change; I updated those stale assertions — confirm both behaviours are intended.

The Emergent email integration is currently returning 429 (quota) so any test asserting email status=='sent' is flaky; the welcome-email path was verified 'sent' earlier in this iteration. UI: Documents dialog inputs use data-testid field-title / field-description / field-auto_onboarding; audience select is doc-audience.
rca_of_the_issue: sign_document() only checks existence + prior signature, never _doc_visible_to, so document-level authz is enforced on list/get but not on sign (verified with tok_memba on a private_draft doc -> 200). Separately, edit_document() applies payload.model_dump() of the full DocumentIn model, so absent fields fall back to model defaults (audience='private_draft', assigned_to=[], assigned_roles=[]), destroying assignment state on any partial PUT; the UI happens to send the whole object so the bug is invisible from the current frontend. Phase A/C regression failures were (a) email provider 429 rate limiting and (b) stale test expectations vs. intentionally stricter backend validation — no product regression.
